info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Market Operation Financial Instrument Valuation-spec
info.description: The Financial Instrument Valuation API enables users to initiate valuations for financial instruments within market operations. This endpoint allows institutions to assess the current market value of various financial products, facilitating accurate financial reporting and decision-making. Typical consumers include financial analysts, portfolio managers, and trading desks who require timely assessments of instrument valuations for strategic planning. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their financial analysis capabilities and ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

post.description: This endpoint allows clients to submit queries for the valuation of financial instruments. The system processes the request and returns the computed valuation based on the provided data and market parameters.

requestBody.description: This request body is used for submitting a financial instrument valuation operation. It requires specific input data related to the financial instrument that needs to be valued.
